questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **First number × Third number = Second number**

Let's check as per the logic,

**First row**- 7, 343, 49 → 7 × 49 = 343

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Fruit : Pomegranate :: Mammal : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second word is a type of the first word.**

**Fruit : Pomegranate** → Pomegranate is a fruit.

Similarly,

**Mammal : ?** → Dog is a Mammal.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Dog"**.

questions.question: Seven boys I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII each have different ages. V is older than only II. I is younger than only VI. III is older than four other boys. VII is younger than IV. Who is the fourth eldest among the boys?
questions.solution:
Seven boys I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII each have different ages.

1. V is older than only II.

_ > _ > _ > _ > _ > V > II 

2. I is younger than only VI.

VI > I > _ > _ > _ > _ > _

3. III is older than four other boys.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No pen is a paper.

All papers are pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pens are pencils.

II. All pencils are pen.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41e59008eb997d70247cd1336b50b7b7cbbcd80eca5cd63997190de49329a8b3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pens are pencils. → Not follow (As, No pen is a paper and All papers are pencils → Some pencils are not pen)

II. All pencils are pen. → Not follow (As, No pen is a paper and All papers are pencils → Some pencils are not pen)

Hence, the correct answer is '**Neither conclusion I nor II follows**'.
